title: Source drift
failure_mode: Concurrent uncommitted backend/client files form an incompatible mixed snapshot
proposed_containment: Freeze per-file hashes and review package/API collision resolutions

title: Worker package overwrite
failure_mode: Local flat workers replace upstream directories or shared schema initializer
proposed_containment: Allowlist union and explicit initializer merges; rerun both suites

title: Wrong visual source
failure_mode: Old client is retained and only linked beside the new dashboard
proposed_containment: Port frozen GitHub tokens/layout/components into the one client

title: Prototype dependencies
failure_mode: Runtime CDN/script or remote font executes in privileged app context
proposed_containment: Bundle assets locally and enforce restrictive CSP

title: Demo status masquerade
failure_mode: API failure produces fake spaces/workers/replies or random telemetry
proposed_containment: Fixture quarantine; explicit unavailable state and measured-only values

title: Home writes memory
failure_mode: Ordinary prompt defaults to the upstream store handler
proposed_containment: Separate chat from explicit reviewed memory intents

title: Two backend owners
failure_mode: New workbench backend and app service open the same embedded stores
proposed_containment: One authenticated owned/paired app runtime; developer workbench not production path

title: Hidden empty data root
failure_mode: Executable move/attach failure creates an empty replacement and appears to lose data
proposed_containment: Stable explicit root identity and recovery-only failure

title: In-memory approval authority
failure_mode: Upstream ApprovalToken bypasses persistent exact service action
proposed_containment: Keep it advisory until qualified adapter; persistent service gate authoritative

title: Forged renderer confirmation
failure_mode: IPC approved flag is treated as native user consent
proposed_containment: Main-owned review reload/callback and final service revalidation

title: Clock rollback
failure_mode: Wall time moves backward and extends one-shot rights
proposed_containment: Wall plus monotonic lifetime; restart expiry

title: Lost accepted request
failure_mode: Reconnect mints another ID after a lost acceptance response
proposed_containment: Main journal, expiring admission namespace and original status observation

title: Compaction revives commands
failure_mode: Old IDs become new after dedup content is pruned
proposed_containment: Retired runtime namespace cannot admit unknown commands

title: False cancellation
failure_mode: UI Stop claims a provider/effect was undone
proposed_containment: Authoritative state race; independent uncertain action/cost accounting

title: Cross-view leakage
failure_mode: Late old-space event or restored selection updates current screen
proposed_containment: Immutable scope/generation routing, selection leases and snapshot resync

title: Frame and integer loss
failure_mode: Large events or JS rounding corrupt identity and recovery
proposed_containment: Exact string IDs, decoders, bounded chunks/buffers and snapshots

title: W01 authority confusion
failure_mode: Reference Orchestrator label grants upstream Intent Analyst trusted identity
proposed_containment: Record naming conflict; trusted orchestrator is not a logical worker

title: Definition is availability
failure_mode: Fixture-tested YAML status becomes enabled/live worker badge
proposed_containment: Separate definition, binding, effective tools, qualification and scope

title: Name-based worker alias
failure_mode: W10 and W35 are interchanged without compatible schemas/disclosure
proposed_containment: Explicit versioned adapter; no name inference or prompt recreation

title: Draft parser limit overrides actual
failure_mode: UI exposes v4 multi-file/5-MiB limits over 2-MiB backend
proposed_containment: Use minimum qualified service/parser/model/root budget

title: False full Forget
failure_mode: Retraction or artifact clear is labelled universal erasure
proposed_containment: Separate controls; barrier/epoch/purge ledger and restore gate

title: Old backup resurrection
failure_mode: Rollback/restore activates forgotten or uncertain state
proposed_containment: Latest verified ledger and compatible isolated activation

title: Account fingerprint confusion
failure_mode: Token file hash or UI selection substitutes stable provider account identity
proposed_containment: Qualified stable account identity plus connection-generation fences

title: Task projection loss
failure_mode: needsAction/date/version discarded or incorrectly shown as synced local item
proposed_containment: Preserve raw state/identity and explicit date/status mapping; independent WorkItems

title: Provider error becomes empty
failure_mode: Rate-limit/partial/auth error renders complete empty day
proposed_containment: Distinct error/partial/coverage/freshness and bounded read retry

title: Workflow budget reset
failure_mode: Child/delegate/retry gets a fresh budget or executes imported forbidden steps
proposed_containment: Root-wide admission and linear typed inclusion validation

title: Scheduler is timer demo
failure_mode: UI interval or timezone math is claimed to be real recurrence
proposed_containment: Actual installed trusted callback, occurrence ledger and standing authority

title: Quit callback leak
failure_mode: Shared Hermes callback dispatches after UI Quit
proposed_containment: Durable app stop epoch and authenticated retired-generation checks

title: Quick chat duplicate runtime
failure_mode: Second window owns another transcript/draft and double-sends
proposed_containment: Shared runtime/canonical conversation, one draft lease and command identity

title: Unknown effect lock bypass
failure_mode: New ID/title/connection generation or 60-row pagination hides uncertainty
proposed_containment: Service stable resource/account/family lock independent of displayed page

title: Deletion secretly retains payload
failure_mode: Fine semantic dedup key keeps erased plaintext or content hash
proposed_containment: Minimal conservative family marker and explicit unresolved restriction

title: Read-only Git overclaim
failure_mode: A qualified local branch operation enables arbitrary reads/hooks/tests/push
proposed_containment: Separate safe read adapter and optional exact-operation variants

title: Manifest only in UI
failure_mode: Disabled route is admitted by API/import/old renderer
proposed_containment: Final service inclusion and current resource authority checks

title: Visual tests overclaim native proof
failure_mode: jsdom/build success is reported as packaged keyboard/dialog/W37 acceptance
proposed_containment: Separate rendered/package/accessibility/live/native tiers

title: Scope creep through sample screens
failure_mode: Notion/pet/fitness/sample automation is enabled to fill the new design
proposed_containment: Explicit screen map, manifest exclusions and absence tests

title: Permission churn
failure_mode: Every repeat compatible read requests another consent or old grant silently widens
proposed_containment: Reuse only matching current authority; new scope/resource reviewed explicitly

title: Package regression concealed
failure_mode: A failed required feature is reclassified optional after its test fails
proposed_containment: Declare variant and acceptance before execution; fail advertised release honestly

title: Source output becomes action
failure_mode: ToolResult/Markdown/citation URI drives a privileged app intent
proposed_containment: Inert rendering; opaque source resolution and trusted intent/review

title: API browser boundary weakened
failure_mode: Prototype fetch wiring is preserved by exposing generic authenticated browser calls
proposed_containment: Port to named Electron bridge; preserve existing Origin rejection

title: Planning becomes implementation
failure_mode: Writing this plan triggers source import, UI/account launch or main merge
proposed_containment: Planning artefacts only until explicit next instruction
